name: Instanced Mouse Grid
description: WebGL isometric grid of instanced 3D shapes that grow in on load and sink, scale and spin around the pointer, with an optional glowing sphere that follows the cursor.
contents: Full-size canvas with a grid of instanced shapes (rounded cube, cylinder, torus or icosahedron)
behavior: Intro animation scales cells in from the center outward
Cells near the smoothed pointer trail sink and can scale or rotate
Cells bob in a gentle wave over time
Pointer and touch movement tracked on the window
editableByProps: Grid density, cell size and shape
Animation speed, wave frequency, pointer influence and intro duration
Follower visibility, size and spin; shadows and pixel ratio cap

needsCodeEdit.where: HemisphereLight, AmbientLight and DirectionalLight lines in start

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how cells react to the pointer

fixed: Root is a full-width h-screen block, override height with className
Listens to window pointermove and touchmove while mounted and removes them on unmount
Pointer tracking only reacts within a 20 unit plane under the grid
